footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units scheduled to vest over a one-year period on November 5, 2027.

Each restricted stock unit ("RSU") represents a contingent right to receive one share of the common stock of Byrna Technologies Inc. (the "Issuer") || The 561 RSUs were granted in connection with the Reporting Person's appointment as an independent director on the Issuer's board of directors and reflect a pro rata share of the equity portion of the base salary of all directors for the Issuer's 2025-26 Annual Meeting Cycle. Pursuant to the terms of the grant, the RSUs vested on September 25, 2026, were required to be settled by March 15, 2027, and were settled on November 6, 2026.
